# PLAN-2 Step 7 Golden Vectors

Shared fixtures proving Rust and Go compute identical `records_root` (Merkle with Hiero prefixes),
`signing_bytes` (136B), and `StateDiff` encoding (sorted LWW, tombstone) byte-for-byte.

## File

- `plan2_golden.json` — deterministic vectors, no randomness, no `OsRng`.
  - `records_root_vectors`: 7 vectors (0,1,2,3,4,5 items plus empty-payload edge) with `expected_root_hex`.
  - `signing_bytes_vectors`: 6 vectors (genesis zeros, chained non-zero, varied round/roster) with 136B `expected_signing_bytes_hex`.
  - `diff_encoding_vectors`: 6 vectors (empty, single put, sorted puts, tombstone, binary keys) with per-diff `proto_hex` (prost == Go deterministic).

Copied to `mirror-node/internal/stream/testdata/plan2_golden.json` (identical).

## Generation

Vectors are deterministic; `expected_*` hex was generated by a temporary Rust
binary in `/tmp/gengolden` that mirrors `consensus::compute_records_root` and
`CheckpointPayload::signing_bytes` exactly (SHA256 domain separation, padded
power-of-two, singleton/internal rules). The binary was run once and the
output committed:

```bash
cargo run --manifest-path /tmp/gengolden/Cargo.toml > consensus-node/protocol/stream/tests/testdata/plan2_golden.json
cp consensus-node/protocol/stream/tests/testdata/plan2_golden.json mirror-node/internal/stream/testdata/plan2_golden.json
```

To regenerate after logic changes (not needed unless Merkle/signing spec changes):

```bash
# 1. Re-run the generator (or update the /tmp/gengolden vectors and re-run).
cargo run --manifest-path /tmp/gengolden/Cargo.toml > consensus-node/protocol/stream/tests/testdata/plan2_golden.json
cp consensus-node/protocol/stream/tests/testdata/plan2_golden.json mirror-node/internal/stream/testdata/plan2_golden.json

# 2. Verify both stacks still agree:
cargo test -p stream --test golden -- --nocapture
CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./mirror-node/internal/stream -run Golden -v
```

## Consumption

- Rust: `consensus-node/protocol/stream/tests/golden.rs` loads this JSON via
  `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR` and asserts `compute_records_root`, `signing_bytes` (136B),
  and `StateDiff` prost encoding match `expected_*_hex`. Run:

  ```bash
  cargo test -p stream --test golden -- --nocapture
  # or workspace:
  cargo test --workspace
  ```

- Go: `mirror-node/internal/stream/golden_test.go` loads the same JSON from
  `testdata/plan2_golden.json` and asserts `ComputeRecordsRoot`,
  `CheckpointSigningBytes`, and `StateDiff` deterministic proto encoding match.

  ```bash
  CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./internal/stream -run Golden -v
  CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./...
  ```

Both stacks use hard-coded hex literals from this file, so a cross-language
byte mismatch fails in CI. No random seeds; fixtures are <100KB textual JSON.
